title: Vivid BAD SQUAD Chapter1 Episode8 Best Place to Practice

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... We're back in the cafe!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What was that all about? We just had a crazy adventure, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. It feels like I just woke up from a dream.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, no! Look at the time! I need to get home!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I guess it is pretty late. Thanks for hanging out. I'll message you later.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, see you later!
Kohane's Room

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew... So much happened today...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I went to Weekend Garage and sang with An...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then we got invited to an event by Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Finally, we ended up in that strange world where we talked with Miku, MEIKO, and even Len...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hahaha. I feel like so much happened that my brain can't keep up.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, it's a message from An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Kohane, are you free after school tomorrow?
Want to come to Vivid Street to practice?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
<Sure, I'll be there.>
Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so glad I worked up the courage to go.
Vivid Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane! Sorry to keep you waiting!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's okay. I just got here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Let's head this way, then.
I've got a special place I like to practice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: Clothing Store Manager
rows.Line: Oh, An! Rumor has it you finally found a singing partner.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hello! I sure did. We're gonna do our best!

rows.Speaker: DJ
rows.Line: Hey there, An! I'm looking forward to the next event!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks! I'll see you there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(An sure is amazing.
She gets along so well with everyone.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And she's so determined to follow her dream, too.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
All right, here we are.
Let's get started, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But this is just a street corner...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. The crowd here is always pretty big, so I know a lot of people will hear us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?! We're going to sing right here?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We'll sing our list from yesterday. A cappella, of course. I'll start us off, so feel free to join in whenever you're ready!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Wow... An really is amazing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(C-Can I really do something like this?
I'm embarrassed and so nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I have to try!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Is that Shiraishi and Azusawa?

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line: Hey, look! There's a couple girls singing over there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(P-People are watching us!
I feel like my voice is going to start trembling!)

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line:
Wow, they're so in sync!
They're pretty good, ay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Oh, but everyone seems like they're enjoying it.
The crowd is starting to grow...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (What is this feeling?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice job, Kohane. That was great considering it was your first time!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, An. I was really nervous, but it felt great when everyone started getting into it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right? Everyone who comes to Vivid Street loves music, so they're always super supportive.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Easy to get hooked, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: ...For sure!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I was thinking about what to call ourselves. I wanted to use the name of the street, so...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Uh huh, so...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: ...I remember when we were like that.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Saying you're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND isn't something you can say half-heartedly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Half-heartedly...
Live House

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Right on time, Toya. You ready?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All right, let's do it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, I'm sure you already know, but remember not to jump into the second song too quickly.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ha. No need to remind me. Tonight's show will be flawless.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If we want to surpass that night, we'll need to be able to overwhelm all comers with our music.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And we definitely can't let ourselves lose to that half-baked pair, am I right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm counting on you tonight, bud.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, I...
